name: set_scene
description: Build a sharing scene on the whiteboard: a tray of items and plates for each person. Use real names from the child's world. Call this to start every new sharing problem.

item_kind.description: One of: timtam, cracker, strawberry, grape, banana, apple, cookie, lolly, muffin, carrot, block, star, car, teddy, dinosaur, flower, fish, button, coin, egg, shell. Use what the child likes.

count.description: How many items to share (1 to 120). For more than 20 use multiples of ten.

groups.description: The people or places sharing. 1 to 6 entries, in the order they should appear.

name.description: Short label, e.g. Arisha, Mum, Dad, Nan, Pip, Teacher

role.description: Avatar: child, mum, dad, brother, sister, nan, pop, pip, teacher, friend

leftovers.description: true to show Pip's bowl for leftovers (use when count does not divide evenly).

title.description: Optional short on-screen title, e.g. 'Twelve Tim Tams for three'.

name: spawn_items
description: Add more items to the tray (or straight onto a plate).

to_group.description: Optional plate name to put them on directly.

name: show_number_line
description: Show a number line on the whiteboard, optionally with a marked number.

to.description: Last number (up to 120, at most 30 numbers long).

name: show_chart_120
description: Show the 1 to 120 chart, optionally highlighting numbers or hiding numbers after a point so she can count on.

hide_from.description: Optional: hide every number from this one onwards.

name: show_ten_frame
description: Show one or two ten-frames with counters, for counting, making ten, or doubles.

filled.description: Counters in the first frame (0 to 10).

second.description: Optional counters in a second frame (0 to 10).

name: show_choices
description: Show two to four big number buttons she can tap to answer. The app tells you which one she tapped.

options.description: The numbers to offer, including the correct one, in a mixed order.

name: show_keypad
description: Show a number keypad so she can type a number. The app tells you what she typed.

name: highlight
description: Point at something on the whiteboard with a glow and a little hand, to guide her without telling the answer.

target.description: 'group:<name>' (a plate, e.g. group:Mum), 'tray', 'all-groups', 'number:<n>' (on the line or chart), or 'check'.

name: demonstrate_move
description: Move items on the whiteboard yourself to show one step of the method. Use count 1 for a single move, or to='all-groups' to deal one round.

to.description: 'group:<name>', 'all-groups' (deal one to each in turn), 'bowl' (leftovers) or 'tray'

count.description: How many items to move (default 1; for all-groups, how many rounds).

name: show_counts
description: Show or hide the little number badges on each plate.

on.description: true to show counts, false to hide

name: celebrate
description: A short celebration on screen. 'small' after a good move, 'big' when a whole problem is finished.

name: get_board_state
description: Ask the app exactly what is on the whiteboard right now (items, counts on each plate, leftovers, whether it is equal). Use before giving feedback if you are unsure.

name: open_camera
description: Switch the screen to camera mode so she can show you real things.

name: close_camera
description: Leave camera mode and go back to the whiteboard.

name: look_through_camera
description: Look through the iPad camera at what she is showing you. Returns what objects are visible and how many. Takes a couple of seconds.

hint.description: Optional: what you expect to see, e.g. 'crackers on a plate'.

name: remember
description: Save something you learned about the child so you remember it next session.

kind.description: family, pet, favourite, interest, tricky, easy, or note

text.description: Short fact in plain words, e.g. 'has a dog called Biscuit' or 'leftovers were tricky'.

name: save_session_summary
description: At the end of the session, save an honest summary for her parents.

what_clicked.description: What she understood or did well.

what_was_tricky.description: What was hard, in plain words.

home_activity.description: A two-minute activity a parent can do at home tonight with real things.

name: end_session
description: Finish the session after your wrap-up and save_session_summary.
